verse: The one who sows to his own flesh, will reap corruption from the flesh; but the one who sows to the Spirit, will reap eternal life from the Spirit. (Gal 6:8)
Those who are of Christ Jesus have crucified their flesh, along with its passions and desires. (Gal 5:24)
You are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, because the Spirit of God dwells in you. (Rom 8:9)
You have heard that it was said, ‘Do not commit adultery.’ But now I say to you that anyone who looks at a woman with lust has already committed adultery with her in his heart. (Matt 5:27-28)

Let us not indulge in sexual immorality, as some of them did, and so twenty-three thousand fell on one day. And let us not test Christ, as some of them did, and so they perished by serpents. (1 Cor 10:8)
Each one of you should know how to control his body in sanctification and honor, not in passions of lust, like the Gentiles who do not know God. (1 Thes 4:4-5)
Let us walk honestly, as in the daylight, not in carousing and drunkenness, not in promiscuity and sexual immorality, not in contention and envy. (Rom 13:13)
The well-being of the heart is life for the flesh. But passion is decay for the bones. (Pro 14:30)

The works of the flesh are obvious: sexual immorality, impurity, sensuality, idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousy, wrath, dissensions, factions, envy, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these. I am warning you, as I warned you before: those who do such things will not inherit the kingdom of God. (Gal 5:19-21)
Because of fornication, impurity, lust, evil desires, and greed, which is idolatry, the wrath of God is coming on those who are disobedient. (Col 3:5-6)
Be on your guard, my son, against every kind of fornication. (Tob 4:12)
Flee fornication! Every sin that a person commits is outside the body; but he who commits fornication sins against his own body. (1 Cor 6:18)
This is the will of God, your sanctification: that you should abstain from fornication. (1 Thes 4:3)
The body is not for fornication, but rather for the Lord; and the Lord is for the body. (1 Cor 6:13)

Fornication or any kind of impurity must not even be named among you, as is proper for saints. Let there be no obscenity, foolish talk, or crude joking, which are out of place; but instead, give thanks. (Eph 5:3-4)

Lift your eyes straight up and see where you did not debase yourself. You were sitting in the roadways, waiting for them, like a robber in the wilderness. And you have polluted the land by your fornications and by your wickedness. For this reason, the rain showers were withheld, and there were no late season rains. (Jer 3:2-3)
To the fornicator every bread is sweet; he can never cease until he dies. (Sir 23:17)
You shall not commit adultery. (Exo 20:14)
Whoever is an adulterer, lacks sense; he will destroy his own soul. He gathers shame and dishonor to himself, and his disgrace will not be wiped away. (Pro 6:32-33)
Because of sexual immorality, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband. (1 Cor 7:2)

Immediately he follows her like an ox led to the slaughter, or like a fool rushing into bonds, until the arrow pierces his liver. It is just as if a bird were to hurry into the snare. And he does not know that his actions endanger his own soul. (Pro 7:22-23)
I say to the unmarried and to widows: It is good for them if they would remain unmarried as I am. But if they cannot control themselves, they should marry. (1 Cor 7:8-9)
You rely on your swords, you do detestable things, and each one of you has defiled his neighbor’s wife; shall you then possess the land? (Eze 33:26)
Why are you seduced, my son, by a strange woman, and why are you kept warm by the bosom of another? (Pro 5:20)

If your right eye causes you to sin, root it out and cast it away from you. For it is better for you that one of your members perish, than that your whole body be cast into Hell. And if your right hand causes you to sin, cut it off and cast it away from you. For it is better for you that one of your members perish, than that your whole body go into Hell. (Matt 5:29-30)

Do not let your heart be pulled into her ways; do not stray into her paths. For she has cast down many wounded, and many who were strong have been slain by her. Her house is the way to hell, leading down to the inner chambers of death. (Pro 7:25-27)
Dine not at all with another man's wife, and strive not with her over wine, lest your heart recline towards her, and by your passion you will fall into destruction. (Sir 9:9)
I have made a covenant with my eyes; how then could I gaze at a virgin? (Job 31:1)
The lips of an immoral woman drip as a honeycomb, and her speech is smoother than oil; but in the end she is bitter as wormwood, sharp as a double-edged sword. (Pro 5:3-4)

Can a person take fire in his bosom, and his garments not burn? Can one walk upon hot coals, and his feet not be scorched? So it is with a person who sleeps with his neighbor’s wife; none who touches her will go unpunished. (Pro 6:27-29)
I found more bitter than death the woman, whose heart is snares and nets, whose hands are chains; the one who pleases God will escape from her, but the sinner will be trapped by her. (Eccl 7:26)
The land is full of adulterers; because of the curse the land mourns, and the fields of the wilderness have dried up. (Jer 23:10)

The one who transgresses against his marriage, despising his own soul, says to himself, “Who can see me? Darkness surrounds me, and the walls enclose me, and no one catches a sight of me. Whom do I fear? The Most High will not remember my sins.” Fearing only human eyes, he does not understand that the eyes of the Lord are ten thousand times brighter than the sun. (Sir 23:18-19)

Do not let your heart covet her beauty, and do not let her captivate you with her glance; for the price of a prostitute is only a loaf of bread, but the wife of another stalks a person’s precious life. (Pro 6:25-26)

Do you not know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? Absolute not! Do you not know that whoever is joined to a prostitute shall become one body with her? For it is said, “The two will become one flesh.” (1 Cor 6:15-16)

My child, give me your heart, and let your eyes observe my ways. For a prostitute is a deep ditch; an immoral woman is a narrow pit. She lies in wait in the way like a robber and causes many to become unfaithful. (Pro 23:26-28)
You should not give yourself, in any way, to prostitutes, lest you destroy your inheritance. (Sir 9:6)
Burning passion is like a hot blazing fire that will not be quenched until it burns itself out; one who commits fornication with his own kin will never cease until the fire breaks forth. (Sir 23:16)
You shall not commit sexual acts with a male, in place of sexual intercourse with a female, for this is an abomination. (Lev 18:22)
If any man has slept with a male in place of sexual intercourse with a female, both have committed an abomination, they shall be put to death; their blood shall be upon them. (Lev 20:13)

Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, which, in like manner as they, indulged in sexual immorality and went after unnatural lust, serve as an example by undergoing the punishment of eternal fire. (Jude 1:7)
The Lord hates all abominations, and those who fear him will not love such things. (Sir 15:13)

Return to the Lord and forsake your sins. Make supplication in the presence of the Lord and diminish your offenses. Return to the Lord, and turn away from your sins, and have immense hatred for what he hates. (Sir 17:25-26)
Return to the Lord your God. For you have been ruined by your own iniquity. Take these words with you and return to the Lord. (Hos 14:1)
Turn now, each one from his evil way, and from your wicked thoughts. And you shall dwell in the land, which the Lord has given to you and to your ancestors from ancient times and forever. (Jer 25:5)
Do not be wise in your eyes. Fear God and depart from evil. (Pro 3:7)
Now, therefore, amend your ways and your intentions, and heed the voice of the Lord your God. And then the Lord will change his mind of the evil that he has spoken against you. (Jer 26:13)
Let us examine our ways, and seek out, and return to the Lord. Let us lift up our hearts, with our hands, toward the Lord in the heavens. (Lam 3:40-41)
Just as you were once determined to go astray from God, now return to him and serve him with ten times more zeal. (Bar 4:28)
Therefore, having these promises, most beloved, let us cleanse ourselves from all defilement of the flesh and of the spirit, perfecting sanctification in the fear of God. (2 Cor 7:1)
